summary.goal: Manage the lifecycle of planning sessions: start, monitor status, terminate on approval, handle timeouts
summary.context: A planning session represents an active planning agent working on a draft plan. Sessions should terminate automatically when the plan is approved (agent can no longer modify). Sessions need timeouts to prevent runaway agents. The UI needs visibility into session status.

acceptance_criteria.description: Planning session created when agent spawned
Session tracks: session_id, plan_id, agent_id, status, started_at, ended_at
Session terminates automatically on plan approval
Session times out after configurable duration (default 30 min)
GET /plans/:id/session returns session status for UI
DELETE /plans/:id/session manually terminates session

steps.title: Define PlanningSession entity
steps.description: Create src/domain/planning-session.ts with interface and factory function.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanningSession interface: { session_id, plan_id, agent_id, status, started_at, ended_at, session_token }
SessionStatus type: 'active' | 'completed' | 'timeout' | 'terminated' | 'error'
createSession(plan_id, agent_id) factory function

steps.title: Add session storage
steps.description: Add planning_sessions table to SQLite schema. Implement CRUD operations in storage layer.

acceptance_criteria.description: planning_sessions table created with all session fields
createSession(session) inserts new session
getSessionByPlanId(plan_id) returns active session or null
updateSessionStatus(session_id, status) updates status and ended_at
getActiveSessions() returns all sessions with status='active'

steps.title: Integrate session creation with agent spawn
steps.description: When planning agent spawned (relay-planning-agent), create PlanningSession record. Session token from spawner stored in session.

acceptance_criteria.description: Session created when spawnPlanningAgent succeeds
Session stores session_token for MCP auth
Plan record references active session_id

steps.title: Terminate session on plan approval
steps.description: Hook into approve workflow: when plan approved, terminate any active planning session. Call terminateAgent from relay-planning-agent.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /plans/:id/versions/:v/approve triggers session termination
Session status set to 'completed'
Agent process terminated via terminateAgent()
Works correctly even if no active session (idempotent)

steps.title: Implement session timeout
steps.description: Add background check for sessions exceeding timeout (configurable via SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES, default 30). Terminate timed-out sessions.

acceptance_criteria.description: SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES env var configures timeout (default 30)
Background check runs every minute for active sessions
Timed-out sessions: status='timeout', agent terminated
Timeout check logged but not noisy

steps.title: Add session API endpoints
steps.description: Add GET /plans/:id/session (get active session status) and DELETE /plans/:id/session (terminate session).

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /plans/:id/session returns { session_id, status, started_at, agent_id } or { status: 'none' } if no active session
DELETE /plans/:id/session terminates active session, returns { success: true, session_id }
DELETE /plans/:id/session returns 404 if no active session

steps.title: Add unit tests for session management
steps.description: Test session lifecycle: creation, status queries, termination on approval, timeout handling.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests for session creation and storage
Tests for session termination on approval
Tests for timeout detection and handling
Tests for API endpoints
